developments.explanation: US October inflation data, due Nov 10, will settle whether Fed Governor Waller backs a half-point rate hike in Dec.
The US and Iran are reportedly nearing an early nuclear deal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for oil tankers.
Iran's foreign minister said peace talks with the US have stalled since the midterms, as President Trump weighs resuming major strikes.
Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation after reports that its CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence.
Iran said 3 tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil route, as traders were betting on a US-Iran deal.
Yemen's Houthi rebels fired missiles at Saudi Arabia's capital, and one reportedly hit an Aramco building in its financial district.
Yemen's Houthi rebels said they fired missiles and drones at Saudi oil sites and the Riyadh airport, a new threat to Gulf oil supplies.
The US expanded its blockade of Iran to target land trade routes and disabled a cargo ship that tried to slip past its navy.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it lifted its limit on missile range after the US carried out new strikes near the Strait of Hormuz.
US officials reportedly believe Nvidia's chief had a romantic tie to a suspected Chinese spy, and Congress has asked him for answers.
The US releases October consumer price data on Nov 10, which should help settle whether the Fed raises interest rates in December.
Investors sold AI stocks on fears Democrats' midterm sweep brings tighter rules, giving Japan's main index its worst week since 2020.
Iranian media said 2 missiles struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, as Trump reportedly weighs new strikes on Iran.
President Trump is reportedly weighing renewed strikes on Iran as early as Nov 9, even as US and Iranian negotiators report progress.
Chip stocks bounced back after their worst drop since 2020, set off by Democratic midterm wins that threaten AI data center growth.
The US added 165,000 jobs in Oct, far above forecasts, strengthening the case for the Fed to raise interest rates in Dec.
Stocks across Asia and Europe fell after US chip shares plunged on fears that Democrats in Congress will curb data center building.
Taiwan stocks had their steepest fall ever and South Korea briefly halted trading as investors sold AI chipmakers after US midterms.
Stocks in Japan and South Korea are falling sharply, extending a US selloff in AI companies after Democrats won the midterm elections.
US chip stocks fell 11% as investors weighed whether the incoming Democratic Congress could slow construction of AI data centers.
The Bank of England raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, saying the Iran war is pushing up UK inflation.
Iran's Guards said 2 oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil route, as Trump weighs a deal or new strikes on Iran.
South Korea's stock market briefly paused trading as chipmaker shares fell sharply on AI spending fears after the US midterms.
Democrats won control of Congress, and Trump said the Iran war angered voters, raising hopes the US will seek a deal to end it.
Vice President Vance said anger over the Iran war cost Republicans Congress, and oil fell 9% on hopes the war will end soon.
After Democrats won Congress, Trump said Iran wants a deal to end the war and it could happen, and oil prices fell about 8%.
President Trump accepted midterm results giving Democrats control of Congress, which could bring tougher rules on AI and crypto.
Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in the midterms, US networks projected, splitting power with President Trump.
Democrats won control of the US House and flipped 3 Republican Senate seats, leaving them one seat short of a Senate majority.
US midterm results will settle who controls Congress, and Democrats flipped a Senate seat in North Carolina, networks projected.
